text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I! Did! It! All! By! My! Seeeelf～～!!

One day, Kawakami Princess was boing-boinging
and hopping all around the rooftop!
choice_data_list: W-What the heck are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, Trainer!?
What perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! I received the most
wonderful fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Kawakami Princess,
Your ferocious running, your daring maneuvers—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I admire how strong and resolute you are, mowing down everything in your path.
I'll train hard too, aiming to become the strongest princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"So that I may challenge you to a Princess Showdown someday. Until then, please hone your legs and await me!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　Sincerely,"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, you are wrong!
The feelings of a true princess have been passed down to a new princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a princess is strong and resilient!
It reached the fans loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: When I read this, I was so, so happy, I felt like I was gonna punch right through the classroom wall!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "I was trying to calm myself down here! Though I'm not calm in the slightest, not at all!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I feel as though I am about to burst with joy!
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Until my strength is spent! Princess Dash!
Here I cooome~~!"

From that day on, Kawakami Princess threw herself
into her training with even greater dedication.
